title: Lab 003 q=3/4 versus corrected signal-only D4 channel-equivalence audit
question: Do the two studies share a physical channel, decoder-visible record, decoder, and logical-loss convention sufficient for direct numerical comparison?
acceptance_items: Compare latent physical events and the meaning of p versus p_X.
Compare local herald conditioning and joint correlation structure.
Compare geometry, boundary conditions, and size labels.
Compare decoder-visible records and decoder configurations.
Classify the relation as exact equivalence, controlled reduction, or non-equivalence and enforce the resulting comparison boundary.
forbidden_inputs: unstable finite-size crossings treated as threshold estimates
claim_boundary: No direct LER or threshold comparison is permitted unless every channel, record, decoder, and loss gate is exact or a fully specified controlled reduction is derived.
